package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationreverseproduct/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationreverseproduct/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationreverseproduct/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

func consume(
	ctx context.Context,
	backend db.Queryer,
	author authors.Author,
) ([]blog.Post, []orm.Predicate[authors.Author], error) {
	relations, err := project.BindReverseRelations()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	predicates, err := relations.AuthorsAuthor.ParseDynamic(nil, []orm.LookupInput{
		{Key: "posts__title", Value: "Alpha"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	predicates = append(predicates, relations.AuthorsAuthor.Posts.Title.Exact("Alpha"))

	objects, err := project.BindReverseObjects()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	object, err := objects.AuthorsAuthor.From(backend, author)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	posts, err := object.Posts()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	rows, err := posts.All(ctx)
	return rows, predicates, err
}
